sovereigns.framework: U.S. Strategic Bitcoin Reserve, formalized March 2026 via executive framework. Holdings comprise BTC previously seized under federal law-enforcement actions, transferred to Treasury and explicitly designated as a strategic reserve asset.
sovereigns.notes: Range commonly cited as 325,000–328,000 BTC depending on attribution of recent transfers. Conservative low-end figure used here.

status_history.note: Pre-formalization holdings from Silk Road and subsequent seizures.

sovereigns.framework: Bitcoin Law (2021); explicit national strategic-reserve framework. Accumulation continues under public 'one BTC per day' policy with periodic top-ups.

sources.label: El Salvador's Bitcoin Reserve Hits 7,565 BTC — MEXC News

sovereigns.notes: First country to formally adopt Bitcoin as legal tender and as a sovereign reserve asset.

sovereigns.framework: Holdings derived from state-operated Bitcoin mining via hydroelectric capacity. Held by Druk Holding & Investments. Materially reduced from ~13,000 BTC peak in 2024–2025 to current level by April 2026.

sources.label: Bhutan quietly moves $42M in Bitcoin in 2026 — Cryptopolitan

sovereigns.notes: Bhutan's path is energy-monetization, not strategic-reserve. Often miscategorized; tracked here as a counter-example for any state considering reserves.

status_history.note: Reclassified as 'divested' after large net sales in early 2026.

sovereigns.framework: Holdings comprise BTC seized in narcotics-trafficking and money-laundering criminal proceedings, held by Finnish Customs (Tulli) and the National Bureau of Investigation (KRP). No public strategic-reserve framework; no treasury designation. Sammallahti and Paasi (Kokoomus MPs) publicly proposed a strategic-reserve framework in May 2026.

sources.label: Sammallahti & Paasi: Suomen valtion pitää omistaa bitcoinia — Kauppalehti

sovereigns.notes: Reserve-framework proposal pending. Whitepaper (publishing 23 May 2026) proposes a 5-year ~0.5%-of-state-assets accumulation path (~6,000 BTC).

sovereigns.framework: Government of Pakistan publicly announced creation of a Strategic Bitcoin Reserve in 2026. Holdings have not yet been publicly verified.

sources.label: Bitcoin Adoption & Regulation: BTC's 2026 Future — Cryptollia

sovereigns.framework: RESBit (Reserva Estratégica de Bitcoin) bill reintroduced in Brazilian Congress in February 2026. Proposes federal accumulation of up to 1,000,000 BTC over 5 years (≈5% of total supply).
sovereigns.notes: Most concrete sovereign-Bitcoin bill text in existence as of May 2026. The Sovereign Monitor tracks RESBit's legislative progress as a leading indicator.

sovereigns.framework: Czech National Bank (ČNB) Governor Aleš Michl publicly discussed Bitcoin as a potential reserve diversifier in 2025 remarks. No bill filed; no treasury position taken.
sovereigns.notes: Closest live European peer to the Finnish reserve proposal.

sovereigns.framework: German Federal Criminal Police Office (BKA) sold approximately 50,000 BTC seized from Movie2K case in mid-2024. No subsequent reserve framework adopted.
sovereigns.notes: Historical example of a state divesting seized BTC prior to the 2025–2026 sovereign-reserve wave.

sovereigns.framework: Holdings comprise BTC under control of state agencies; mix of donations to the war effort and seizures. No formal strategic-reserve framework.
sovereigns.notes: Holdings figure widely cited but subject to wartime classification uncertainty.

sovereigns.framework: Holdings comprise BTC seized by UK law-enforcement (notably ~61,000 BTC seized in 2018 from a single Chinese money-laundering case). Held by HMRC / Crown Prosecution Service pending forfeiture proceedings. No strategic-reserve framework.
sovereigns.notes: Status could shift to 'strategic_reserve' or 'divested' depending on outcome of forfeiture proceedings.

sovereigns.framework: Holdings comprise BTC seized in PlusToken and related fraud cases. Held by Chinese state agencies. No public strategic-reserve framework and no recent on-chain confirmation; figure is a widely cited estimate.
sovereigns.notes: Highest-uncertainty data point in the Monitor. Treat as estimate, not verified.
